headline: Easement at 3360 Whitney Avenue, $1.5M Newhall foundation repair contract, and $3.5M Fire Station 2 grant application.
summary: Grant applications for Fire Station 2 and a Dixwell Avenue transit planning study are due December 4, 2026. The agenda covers a pending resolution on 2447 Whitney Avenue, followed by an executive session.

b 250, 000 grant Bus Rapid Transit project  
      
 
 
Grants & Capital Projects - Resolution to apply for, accept and expend funds if 
awarded, Round 10 of CT DECD's Community Investment Fund 
- $250,000 planning grant application for community engagement and planning studies 
for improvements to support transit-oriented development along the Dixwell Avenue 
corridor to leverage the forthcoming Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) project. The grant 
application will also include planning for the eventual reuse of Fire Station 2. The 
application is due no later than 12pm on December 4, 2026. 
      
       c Resolution DECD 3.5 M Fire Station 2  
      
 
 
Grants & Capital Projects - Resolution to apply for, accept and expend funds if 
awarded, Round 10 of CT DECD's Community Investment Fund 
- $3.5M capital grant reapplication for Fire Station 2. The reapplication will include 
project updates since the CIF R9 application. The application is due no later than 12pm 
on December 4, 2026.
